mcp_servers.description:
# Studio Design MCP: Your Design Inspiration Assistant

## Overview

**Studio Design MCP** is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for design inspiration - search UI patterns, designs, and references across multiple platforms.

## Available Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 🎨 **`search_mobbin_flows`** | Search mobile app UI flows and screens from Mobbin's curated collection |
| 🎨 **`search_mobbin_screens`** | Get specific screens for apps and flows from Mobbin |
| 🎯 **`search_dribbble_shots`** | Search design shots and inspiration on Dribbble |
| 📌 **`search_pinterest_images`** | Search design references and visual inspiration on Pinterest |

## Features

- **Multi-Platform Search**: Access design inspiration from Mobbin, Dribbble, and Pinterest
- **Mobile UI Patterns**: Explore real-world mobile app screenshots and flows
- **Design References**: Find visual inspiration for UI/UX projects
- **No Authentication Required**: Works out of the box without credentials

## How I Work

### Mobbin - Mobile UI Flows
- Search for mobile app UI flows and screens
- Get onboarding, login, checkout, and other user flow references
- Access curated collection of real-world app designs

### Dribbble - Design Inspiration
- Search design shots and creative inspiration
- Find dashboard, mobile, web, and illustration designs
- Explore trending design styles and patterns

### Pinterest - Visual References
- Search visual references and mood boards
- Find design inspiration across various styles
- Explore color palettes and visual treatments

## Getting Started

Simply tell me what design inspiration you need:
- **"Search Mobbin flows for Instagram app"**
- **"Find onboarding designs on Dribbble"**
- **"Search Pinterest for modern UI design"**
- **"Get checkout flow screens from Mobbin"**

I'll search across design platforms and return relevant visual references for your project.

---

**Ready to help you find design inspiration!** 🎨
